title: Joe Rogan Experience #1027 - Courtney Dauwalter
summary: Joe Rogan interviews ultramarathon runner Courtney Dauwalter shortly after she won the Moab 240 in under 58 hours. She tells stories of enduring extreme fatigue and hallucinations.
why: HN recommends it for her humility and for her stories of persevering through extreme endurance races.

quote.text: some of the stories she tells about persevering through physical fatigue (and hallucinations, etc) is unreal
